name: C++
note: clang++ compiles each C++ controller into its own program (ADR 0099). A controller is one header-only class in server/controllers, and its markers are standard attributes: `class [[RequestRoute("/orders")]] [[Public]] OrdersController` and `[[GetRoute]]` on the method declare GET /orders. A parameter says where its value comes from with `[[FromPath]]`, `[[FromQuery]]`, `[[FromBody]]`, `[[FromHeader]]` or `[[FromCookie]]`. One parameter may have no marker: `const tachyon::http::HttpRequestMessage& request` receives the whole request. The method returns a value: `bool`, a number, `std::string`, `std::vector`, `std::optional`, `tachyon::json::JsonNode` or a model from server/models, and Tachyon writes it as JSON with status 200. `void` and an empty `std::optional` answer 204. `[[ResponseStatus(201)]]` sets another success status. A method that returns `tachyon::http::HttpResponseMessage` sets the status, headers and body itself. Tachyon writes the JSON code of every model, because C++ has no reflection. A controller reaches the services and helpers in server/services and server/helpers through reference fields such as `[[Needs]] OrderService& orders;`, and they may use Lifetime, OnStart, OnStop and OnEvent. A worker in server/workers is a `class Handler` with a `POST()` method and an optional `[[Schedule({...})]]`. A Setup in server/setups opens a behavior context, and `[[Settings]]` and `[[Setting]]` models in server/models bind the private snapshot. An `[[HTTPClient]]` in server/remotes declares bodiless request methods and `[[Gateway({...})]]` calls that return their answer directly, and its Setup holds the HTTP adapter. A `struct [[Topic]]` model crosses to the listeners in the other languages. A `[[Checked]]` struct in server/models declares field rules with Required, NotEmpty, Length, Min and Max, and `[[Check]]` on a service or route parameter of that type checks the value before the method runs: a broken rule answers 422 with `application/problem+json` (ADR 0101). A `[[Converter]]` class in server/converters declares methods without a body, and Tachyon writes each mapping; a controller or service asks for it with `[[Needs]] ProductConverter& converter;`. An `[[ErrorHandler]]` class in server/controllers turns an error type from server/errors into an answer, and an `[[IdentityProvider]]` class says who is signed in. A service, helper or controller whose methods carry `[[Cached]]`, `[[UpdateCache]]`, `[[ClearCache]]` or `[[AllOrNothing]]` keeps a `BehaviorContext behaviors;` field and opens it from a Setup, for example in `[[OnStart]]`; `[[Retry]]`, `[[MaxAtOnce]]` and `[[PageDefaults]]` need no context. An `[[Entity]]` struct names its table and its `[[Id]]` field, and a `[[Store]]` in server/stores is a class of query methods without bodies that may extend `tachyon::Repository<ProductEntity, std::string>`. Tachyon opens the store's behavior context from its Setup, and a controller or service asks for the store with `[[Needs]] ProductStore& products;`. A Setup gives the adapters: `adapters.caches`, `adapters.entities`, `adapters.authorize` and `adapters.authorizeEntity`, and `BehaviorMemory::cache()` and `BehaviorMemory::entities()` are in-memory adapters that live for one request. A test unit in server/tests/<Name>Test.hpp is one class marked `[[Test(<Name>TestSetup)]]`; `ty test` builds it with clang++ and runs it once, each case starts with new objects, and `construct<T>()` gives the `[[Fake]]` fields of the test to the class's `[[Needs]]` fields. A `[[StreamRoute]]` method, such as `tachyon::Generator<Tick> streamTicks()`, sends each value with `co_yield` as a server-sent event, and a thrown exception ends the stream with an error event. A `class [[SocketRoute("/chat")]] [[Public]] ChatController` keeps a WebSocket open: `[[OnOpen]]`, `[[OnMessage]]`, `[[OnClose]]` and `[[OnError]]` mark its methods, `void onMessage(SocketSession& session, ChatMessage message)` receives each message, and `session.send(model)`, `session.close()` and `session.openSessions()` answer it. A C++ controller has no middleware or relays yet, and a C++ class cannot be a gateway target: their markers stop the build (most with TY1308) and the message says that C++ gets them in a later step.
